title: Hearty Indulgent Kenyan Cheese Lasagna
description: A rich and flavorful Kenyan dish featuring layers of cheese, pasta, and chimichurri sauce, finished with a tempering chocolate drizzle.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese.
Spread a layer of chimichurri sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the chimichurri sauce.
Spread half of the cheese mixture on top of the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the chimichurri sauce, and finally the remaining cheese mixture.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Melt the tempering chocolate and drizzle over the top of the lasagna.
Sprinkle the kenyan tea leaves and salt to taste over the top of the lasagna.
